reports.title: Monday Night Halftime Report: The Scoreboard Is Frozen Solid Like a Philly Pretzel in January!
reports.text:
Scoreboard's on ice, folks: the data's frozen at 7:25 AM CT, before Cowboys at Eagles even kicked. Rich, open the Bet Tracker app and thaw this thing out! Here's what's on file.

**MY BETS:** 0-0, $0.00 on $0.00 staked tonight. Not one bet in the tracker. Either Rich sat this one out like a sensible adult, or he's betting from the couch and not reporting it. Rich, we see you. Whoop!

**AI-LOX:** No picks tonight. The computer looked at Dallas-Philly and said "I'll pass." For once, the computer showed some restraint.

**THE MODEL:** One game on the board, still showing pregame on the frozen data: Dallas "America's Team, America's Heartbreak" Cowboys 24, Philadelphia "Fly, Eagles, Fly-by-Night" 22 (most likely score 23-20). So the computer takes Dallas outright, but says Philly +4.5 covers (model has them losing by only 2.6). Total: model 45.8 vs a 43.5 line, so it leans over... even though its own Monday-night-under flag is waving. The computer is arguing with itself, folks. Back-back-back-back to the drawing board! No finals yet, so no closest call or worst miss.

**SECOND HALF:** Nothing riding, so Rich just needs to open the app and keep the computer honest. That's why they play the games!

reports.title: Sunday Night Final: the scoreboard's frozen at 9:42 PM CT — open the Bet Tracker, Rich, the app's been napping like a Seahawk on a 10-point lead.
reports.text:
**MY BETS:** 2-2 settled, **+$17.25** on $124.74 staked. Pittsburgh "Steel Curtain Call" under 42.5 cashed +$40, and the G-Men +10.5 rumbled, bumbled, stumbled into OT and won outright, +$17.02. Then the Bucs went Buc-wild, 43-13, torching your TB/CAR under (-$19.80) AND the CAR -2.5 leg of your 3-leg parlay (-$19.97; all three legs lost, a perfect 0-fer, whoop!). Night game: the 4-leg overs parlay ($24.99 to win $347.11) hit three legs, then KC-SEA froze at 13-3 with 12:27 left, needing 27 more points. That parlay is on life support with the plug in Rich's hand. If it dies, the day is -$7.74.

**AI-LOX:** 1-1, **-$5.91** on $130 at suggested stakes: PIT/NO under 44.5 won, TB/CAR under 44.5 got Brady-ghosted by 11.5. Rich was on both (1-1, +$20.20). The wind rule blew both ways.

**THE MODEL:** 7 of 11 winners, 5-6 vs the spread, 8-3 on totals, average miss 10.3 points. Closest call: Cleveland 27-24 Tennessee (model 21-18), Browns-ie points. Worst miss: Tampa 43-13 Carolina; the computer said 21-19 Panthers. Somebody unplug it, blow on the cartridge, plug it back in. Live: model had KC 23-22, Chiefs trail 13-3. Arrowhead? More like Arrow-dead.

That's why they play the games. Back-back-back-to work tomorrow!

reports.title: Afternoon catch-up: the early AND late windows, all in one, because the computer forgot to ring the doorbell!
reports.text:
**MY BETS: 2-2, +$17.25 on the day.** He could... go... all... the... way... to the window, twice! The **Steelers-Saints under** cashed (+$40), and **Giants +10.5** didn't just cover, the G-Men won outright 27-21 in overtime. Whoop!

Now the Carolina Experience. Rich took **Panthers -2.5** in a 3-leg parlay *and* the **Bucs-Panthers under**. Tampa Bay hung **43** on them, 43-13. The under lost by 10.5, the parlay died on that leg, and the Jets leg didn't make it either. Rumblin', bumblin', stumblin'... right off a cliff. Betting both sides of the Panthers is like buying two tickets on the Titanic.

**The 4-leg overs combo is ALIVE, 3 for 3:**
- Giants-Texans 48 (needed 43)
- Browns-Titans 51 (needed 37)
- 49ers-Falcons **49 (needed 48.5)**. By half a point! That's why they play the games!

**All that's left: Chiefs-Seahawks over 42.5 tonight, for $372.10.**

**AI-LOX: 1-1, -$5.91.** The computer liked the same Bucs-Panthers under. Somebody check its wiring.

**THE MODEL:** 6 of 10 winners, 6-4 vs the spread, 6-4 on totals, missing margins by 10.1 points on average. Closest call: Browns 27-24 (model had 21-18). Worst miss: it had **Carolina winning 21-19**. Instead it was 43-13. Unplug it, plug it back in, see if that helps.

**Tonight:** your $372 needs 43 points out of Kansas City and Seattle. Halftime report at 8:50.
